title: Corpus harness flags entries with no golden
lead: The private-corpus harness (sq-18) reports an entry that has no golden as "no golden" (not passed), and a run with any such entry says so in its summary; an option can make that a failure. **Not in this slice:** recording goldens for the private corpus.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Today an entry with no golden passes, so a green corpus run only shows that profiling did not crash. A consumer review (2026-10-30) read a green run as coverage of a format family that had no goldens at all.
